name: three-shifts
description: Cyclic shift execution engine. Plans tasks 3x daily (6 AM, 2 PM, 10 PM), decomposes them into granular steps, then executes via 15-minute cron cycles. Each cycle reads state files, picks the next step, executes it, writes results back. Errors are logged and skipped — never fatal. Planning uses Claude 4.6; execution uses GLM-5.
